summary: Capabilities-Exchange: negotiates supported applications, security and identities when a Diameter peer connection is established.
Device-Watchdog: heartbeat that detects transport/peer failures when no other traffic is flowing.
Disconnect-Peer: cleanly tears down a peer connection, signalling the disconnect cause.
Re-Auth: server-initiated request asking the client to re-authorize/re-authenticate an existing session (e.g. PCRF pushing new rules).
Session-Termination: client tells the server a session has ended so accounting/resources can be released.
Abort-Session: server-initiated request asking the client to stop a specific session immediately.
Accounting: carries offline-charging accounting records (start/interim/stop/event) from a node to the charging system.
Credit-Control: requests/grants units of credit for online charging and policy (Gy quota, Gx policy install).
AA (Authentication/Authorization): requests authorization for a session; on Rx the AF (P-CSCF) installs media/QoS info into the PCRF.
Diameter-EAP: tunnels EAP exchanges for non-3GPP access authentication (trusted/untrusted WLAN).
Update-Location: MME/SGSN registers the UE's serving node with the HSS and downloads subscription data on attach/TAU.
Cancel-Location: HSS tells the old MME/SGSN to delete a subscriber, e.g. after the UE attaches elsewhere.
Authentication-Information: MME/SGSN fetches EPS authentication vectors (RAND/AUTN/XRES/KASME) from the HSS.
Insert-Subscriber-Data: HSS pushes updated subscription data to the MME/SGSN.
Delete-Subscriber-Data: HSS instructs the MME/SGSN to remove specified parts of the stored subscription data.
Purge-UE: MME/SGSN informs the HSS it has flushed a detached/idle subscriber's context.
Reset: HSS notifies MMEs that it has restarted so they re-register affected subscribers.
Notify: MME/SGSN reports events to the HSS (e.g. UE reachable, PDN-GW identity for emergency/UE-requested PDN).
ME-Identity-Check: MME/SGSN checks an IMEI(SV) against the EIR to allow/deny the device (white/grey/black list).
User-Authorization (IMS): I-CSCF asks the HSS whether a user may register and which S-CSCF (or capabilities) to use.
Server-Assignment (IMS): S-CSCF stores/clears its name in the HSS and downloads the user profile on registration.
Location-Info (IMS): I-CSCF queries the HSS for the S-CSCF currently serving a user (for terminating requests).
Multimedia-Auth (IMS): S-CSCF fetches authentication vectors (e.g. AKA) from the HSS to challenge a registering user.
Registration-Termination (IMS): HSS tells the S-CSCF to deregister a user (admin, re-assignment, etc.).
Push-Profile (IMS): HSS pushes updated user profile or auth data to the serving S-CSCF.
User-Data (Sh): SIP Application Server reads transparent/repository user data from the HSS.
Profile-Update (Sh): Application Server writes updated user data back to the HSS.
Subscribe-Notifications (Sh): Application Server subscribes to be notified when specified HSS user data changes.
Push-Notification (Sh): HSS notifies a subscribed Application Server that user data has changed.
Provide-Location (SLg): GMLC requests the current location of a UE from the serving MME (EPC-LCS).
Location-Report (SLg): MME reports a UE location event/result to the GMLC (deferred or event-triggered).
LCS-Routing-Info (SLh): GMLC queries the HSS for the serving MME/SGSN of a target UE (LCS routing).
Spending-Limit (Sy): PCRF requests policy counter status (spending limits) from the OCS.
Spending-Status-Notification (Sy): OCS notifies the PCRF when a subscribed policy counter / spending limit changes.
Configuration-Information (S6t): SCEF configures monitoring events / communication patterns for a UE in the HSS.
Reporting-Information (S6t): HSS reports monitoring-event data to the SCEF.
NIDD-Information (S6t): authorizes/configures Non-IP Data Delivery for a UE between SCEF and HSS.
Connection-Management (T6a/T6b): MME/SGSN establishes/updates/releases a NIDD/monitoring connection with the SCEF.
MO-Data (T6a/T6b): carries Mobile-Originated Non-IP data from the MME/SGSN to the SCEF.
MT-Data (T6a/T6b): carries Mobile-Terminated Non-IP data from the SCEF to the MME/SGSN.
MO-Forward-Short-Message (SGd): forwards a Mobile-Originated SMS from the MME/SGSN towards the SMS-GMSC/IWMSC.
MT-Forward-Short-Message (SGd): delivers a Mobile-Terminated SMS from the SMS-GMSC to the serving MME/SGSN.
Send-Routing-Info-for-SM (S6c): SMS-GMSC asks the HSS for the routing info / serving node to deliver an SMS.
Alert-Service-Centre (SGd/S6c): tells the SMS service centre that a previously unreachable UE is now available for SMS.
Report-SM-Delivery-Status (S6c): reports SMS delivery outcome to the HSS so it can update message-waiting data.
